input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data.

reference_csv.description: Path to reference organisms CSV samplesheet.
reference_csv.help_text: A CSV file listing reference genomes to spike into background datasets. Must contain 'id', 'accession', and 'path' columns, and may include optional integer 'taxon_id' and a required 'study_id' recorded in the metadata CSV for every sample spiked with that reference. Provide exactly one of 'accession' or 'path' for each reference row.

dataset_csv.description: Path to background datasets CSV samplesheet.
dataset_csv.help_text: A CSV file listing ONT background datasets. Must contain 'id', 'accession', and 'reads' columns, and may include optional 'source_climb_id'. Provide exactly one source per row: an SRA accession or a local/S3 FASTQ path in 'reads'.

store_options.title: Store options
store_options.description: Directories for caching downloaded reference genomes and datasets.

store_dir.description: Directory to cache downloaded reference genomes and dataset FASTQ files.
store_dir.help_text: Downloads are saved under 'references/<id>/' and 'datasets/<id>/' in this directory and reused across pipeline runs.

simulation_design_options.title: Simulation design options
simulation_design_options.description: Parameters controlling the simulation experiment design.

coverages.description: Comma-separated list of target spike-in coverage depths to simulate.
coverages.help_text: Each reference genome will be spiked into each background dataset at each of these coverage levels. Override with e.g. --coverages '1,10,50'.

downsample_background.description: Downsample each background dataset with Rasusa before spiking (opt-in).

downsample_bases.description: Total bases to downsample each background dataset to (with --downsample_background).
downsample_bases.help_text: Passed to Rasusa --bases. Supports suffixed values like '10k' (10,000 bases).

tag_simulated_reads.description: Append simulator-specific tags to simulated read IDs before mixing them with background reads.
tag_simulated_reads.help_text: When enabled, simulated read IDs are tagged with '_badread' in the retained read ID token, so uploaded reads can be identified after ingest assigns new sample IDs.

badread_per_segment.description: Run Badread independently for each FASTA record before concatenating segment reads.
badread_per_segment.help_text: Useful for segmented references where every segment should be represented. Changes low-coverage semantics because Badread crosses the target independently for each FASTA record.

badread_low_coverage_cutoff.description: Coverage threshold at or below which Badread uses badread_low_coverage_length.

badread_low_coverage_length.description: Badread length distribution to use for coverages at or below badread_low_coverage_cutoff.

badread_qscore_model.description: Badread quality score model to use.

badread_junk_reads.description: Percentage of junk reads in Badread output.

badread_random_reads.description: Percentage of random reads in Badread output.

badread_chimeras.description: Percentage of chimeric reads in Badread output.

badread_seed.description: Random number generator seed for deterministic Badread output.

metadata_options.title: Metadata options
metadata_options.description: Parameters for optional DB-ingest metadata CSV generation.

generate_metadata.description: Generate a metadata CSV for DB ingestion at the end of the pipeline.

auto_ingest.description: Upload generated metadata and FASTQ files to ingest bucket set in HYDRASIM_UPLOAD_BUCKET.

metadata_sample_source.description: Sample source to record in the metadata CSV (e.g. upper_respiratory).

metadata_sample_type.description: Sample type to record in the metadata CSV.

metadata_governance_status.description: Governance status to record in the metadata CSV.

metadata_input_type.description: Input type to record in the metadata CSV.

metadata_spike_in.description: Spike-in value to record in the metadata CSV.

metadata_received_date.description: Received date (ISO format). Defaults to the date the pipeline was run.
